specs.Other Special Features of the Product: Built In Cable, Fast Charging, Magsafe, Wireless Charging

features: 10000mAh Backup Power: Equipped with a lithium-polymer battery that provides reliable backup power for phones, earbuds, and everyday accessories.
15W Magnetic Wireless Charging: Provides secure magnetic alignment and charges compatible iPhones wirelessly without a separate cable.
Built-In Lightning Cable: Features an integrated Lightning cable directly on the power bank, offering ready charging for iPhone users.
22.5W USB-C PD Charging: Delivers up to 22.5W Power Delivery for rapid wired charging when you need to power up your devices quickly.
Works with Phones, Earbuds and More: Supports standard charging for phones, earbuds, and common USB-powered accessories.
